versions.changelog:
paper-introduction-writer v1.0.0

- Initial release of the Paper Introduction Writer skill.
- Generates, revises, or annotates academic paper introductions using Glasman-Deal’s 4-component/11-sentence model.
- Supports English drafts, Chinese functional annotations, paragraph outlines, revision of existing introductions, and short introduction exercises (250-350 words) per §1.6.
- Interactive workflow collects paper topic, field, gap, method, and contribution before writing.
- Offers discipline-specific templates and ensures logical, well-structured introductions with proper academic conventions.
